shared_elements: tall vertical panel filled edge-to-edge with low-relief carving
rectangular framed compartments/blocks of relief detail
densely worked surface with rounded, softly modelled forms
justification: Both are tall upright panels carved in shallow relief with compartmentalised, densely detailed forms filling the whole vertical field, and both use similar rounded, low-relief modelling conventions. But what is depicted differs fundamentally: A shows a large standing human figure in profile with an elaborate headdress and a small crouching/bound figure at its feet, while B shows only stacked columns of square, rounded-corner sign blocks with no figural scene at all.
